sources.finding: Official final gamebook supplies the full lineups, substitutions, DNPs, inactives, participation, score, regulation duration and play-by-play injury timing. Atlanta C.J. Henderson was injured with 13:27 left in Q1 and reported returned after the 13:03 play; Za'Darius Smith was injured on the 13:03 Q1 play and recorded one defensive snap; New Orleans Davon Godchaux received a return-questionable update with 7:43 left in Q4 after his last recorded tackle involvement with 3:56 left in Q2.

Atlanta's official inactive report states that the active roster entered with a clean and healthy slate, confirms Divine Deablo and Samson Ebukam active, and lists Cooper Rush, Jack Strand, Malcom Dewalt IV, Roger Longerbeam, Jared Ivey and Ethan Onianwa as inactive.

New Orleans' official inactive report identifies Kaden Elliss, Carl Granderson, Anfernee Jennings and Noah Fant as injury absences, Zach Wilson as the designated third quarterback, and Decamerion Richardson and Christen Miller as the other inactives.

The final official injury report rules Kaden Elliss, Carl Granderson and Anfernee Jennings out, lists Noah Fant questionable, and records Christen Miller as a full participant without a game designation. It also records the active questionable and full-participation players reviewed against the gamebook.

Official depth roles identify the available same-group reserves used only for additional vacant duties. The final gamebook independently confirms Danny Stutsman, Tyree Wilson, Fadil Diggs, Oscar Delp and John Ridgeway III were game-available participants.

The club identifies Chase Young and Cameron Jordan as retaining their edge roles without Carl Granderson's rotation, supporting assignment of separate added reserve duties without crediting either incumbent baseline starter as a replacement.
The club states Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller will handle Travis Etienne Jr.'s vacated load while CJ Donaldson retains a separate role.
Official postgame notes corroborate the final game and active offensive roles; they do not add a quarterback or specialist injury loss.

cases.rationale: The gamebook records an injury at 13:27 Q1 and a return update after the 13:03 play. His frozen healthy value is zero, so the replacement-aware loss is mathematically zero for any unavailable fraction.
cases.assumptionRationale: Frozen healthy value is zero and every calibrated non-QB replacement value is nonnegative; no missing identity or value is treated as zero.

cases.rationale: The gamebook records Smith injured at 13:03 Q1, no return, and one defensive snap. Samson Ebukam was active and is assigned only the additional edge vacancy duty.
cases.roleRationale: Ebukam was an active same-group edge participant after being confirmed available. The documented-depth assignment estimates only the added vacancy duty and does not remove his existing baseline contribution.
cases.assumptionRationale: Assign Samson Ebukam as the available primary additional-duty edge replacement; this is a retrospective role estimate, not a measured snap allocation.
cases.baselineRationale: Ebukam's existing rotational baseline duty is retained; only Smith's added vacant edge duty is valued.

exposure.assumptionRationale: Use the exact official play-by-play injury time through the end of regulation; elapsed game time approximates unavailable duties, not snap share. Active periods are valued normally.
